notes.title: Chinese Language Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
We're pleased to announce that the Chinese language version of Sound of Drop is now available on Steam. The update was just pushed a few minutes ago so if you already have it installed, you should be able to access the Chinese version by going to the language tab under properties via your game library.

Please enjoy!

notes.title: French and Russian Language Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've updated Sound of Drop to include French and Russian language options. The French language translation comes courtesy of [url=https://kawasoft.fr/]Kawasoft[/url] and the Russian language translation comes courtesy of [url=http://enthusiasts-ts.ru/]Entuziasty Team[/url]. We would like to thank both teams for their hard work on this title.

To select a different language for Sound of Drop, right click on the game title inside the library of your Steam client and select Properties. Under the Language tab you can choose a different language which will then begin the process of downloading the corresponding localization files.

[b]Please Note[/b]: You may need to restart your Steam client prior to changing languages. This will only need to be done once.

notes.title: One Week to Go on Fatal Twelve Kickstarter Page
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28364974/7bc7387a1c232ed21a772334c4ea33cea42894f4.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone!

Just a heads up that there's less than a week to go before the Fatal Twelve Kickstarter concludes.

Currently, the campaign is less than $4,500 away from reaching the first stretch goal which will add Chinese and French as available languages in the game. There's a lot of cool stuff left to be snapped up including original artwork by character designer, Shio Koji and autographed artwork by some of the Japanese voice cast as well. Check out the lovely illustration that was done to celebrate hitting the initial funding goal!

To better get to know some of the characters as well, some of the girls have gotten together to talk about their thoughts on how Kickstarter works in this informative YouTube video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zpj1vNlwqEU&t=14s

For More Information:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sekaiproject/fatal-twelve-a-thrilling-mystery-vn-with-full-voic/

notes.title: Sound of Drop - fall into poison - Official Soundtrack Released
Sound of Drop - fall into poison - Official Soundtrack Released
Achievements enabled + small bug fixes
notes.notes:
version 151107:

- Added Steam support and 21 achievements. CGs and endings related achievements should automatically unlock at first boot, the others have to be unlocked manually. However, every achievement unlocked offline from this version will be granted at boot if connected to Steam.
  
- Fixed a typo in the Japanese version.

- The movies were re-encoded at a lower FPS. This should fix the problem someone had playing movies while using the hardware rendering.
